node.label: Persistent fetal circulation
node.definition: Systemic desaturation of a liveborn baby resulting from persistent pulmonary hypertension with a patent ductus arteriosus and patent foramen ovale, such that the circulation in postnatal life follows the fetal course.

evidence.snippet: Craniofaciofrontodigital syndrome: Persistent fetal circulation (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
